Not missing information. Missing the connections.

Your organisation isn't missing information. It's missing the connections between it.

Knowledge is spread across meetings, documents, projects, people and business systems. Decisions are repeated. Work is duplicated. Valuable experience disappears when people leave. OI Workforce connects what your organisation already knows and turns it into a capability that improves every day.

See what your organisation could become →
My OI: your executive office

Not a chatbot. Where you delegate real work and it actually gets done.

Ask it to prepare a board pack, analyse last quarter's financials, or research a topic. It doesn't reply with a paragraph. It delivers exactly what you'd hand to a real chief of staff. It gathers information across every connected system, narrates exactly what it's doing while it works, and hands back a finished deliverable in whatever form you actually need it: read aloud, a summary, a full report, or a slide deck.

  • Talks through its own process in real time, step by step
  • Voice or type, same conversation, same memory
  • Delivers in the format you actually need next

The knowledge bank

If people leave, their knowledge shouldn't.

Every meeting, decision and project OI has ever touched becomes part of a permanent record: not a document nobody opens again, but something the next team can actually build on, years later.

The old way

An employee leaves. Whatever they knew, the context, the reasoning, the lessons from what worked and what didn't, leaves with them. The next person starts from zero.

With OI Workforce

Nothing leaves. What OI saw, decided, and learned becomes part of the organisation's permanent memory: available to whoever needs it, whenever they need it, no matter who's still there to ask.

What this looks like two years on

A new team starting a project OI has seen a version of before doesn't start from a blank page. It gets briefed on what a similar project, even one completed years earlier by people no longer at the organisation, actually decided, what worked, what didn't, and why. Not a search result. A briefing, built from your own organisation's evidence.

The loop behind every answer

Ask once. Watch it get smarter every time.

Every query doesn't just get answered. It makes the next one better. Here's what actually happens between asking and delivering.

1
Query arrives
Typed or spoken, from any consultant's My OI.
2
Searches the knowledge bank
Not the internet. The organisation's own ingested meetings, messages, documents and past projects.
3
Routes to the right specialist
LLM Logic picks from 136+ models: the one built for this exact task, not a generalist forced to do it all.
4
Specialists get to work
Each chosen model works its part (video, translation, financial reasoning) in parallel.
5
Compiles and asks
Results become one answer. You choose how you want it: read aloud, summary, full report, slide deck.
6
Learns and stores
Which models worked best gets remembered. The finished output joins the knowledge bank, ready for the next question.

This closes the loop. The finished output and the model choices that worked feed straight back into step 1, so the organisation's next question starts smarter than this one did.

Architecture

How it's actually built, in five parts.

1

Multi-model intelligence engine

Not every AI model can watch a video, translate Twi accurately, or reason through a financial model equally well. LLM Logic reads the task and routes it to whichever model, cloud or fully offline, actually does that job best, automatically, at no extra cost.

2

Sovereign intelligence architecture

Cloud, private enterprise cloud, or fully offline: your data can stay entirely within your own infrastructure, and the platform runs without needing an internet connection at all, built for villages, mines and other underserved-connectivity regions.

3

Decision intelligence layer

Before OI recommends anything, it checks: is this actually allowed here, who needs to sign off, and what happened last time someone tried this? Every recommendation comes with its reasoning attached. Nothing gets rubber-stamped.

4

Predictive work intelligence

It knows what's coming from your calendar and what happened last time something similar came up, and has it ready before you've asked for it.

5

Organisational memory

When a human employee leaves, their knowledge walks out the door with them. When it's in OI's memory, it doesn't. A project from five years ago is still there to hand a new team the lessons learned, the framework, and what actually worked, the same way a long-serving employee would.

Legal

Plain language, before the formal language.

Since sovereignty and data handling are central to what OI Workforce does, here's a direct summary of each policy, not just a link to a document nobody reads.

Draft, pending legal review

Privacy

We collect the minimum data needed to run your account and the platform itself, never anything beyond that, and never sold to third parties.

  • Signup and contact details, kept only for as long as your account is active
  • Usage data used to improve the product, never to profile individual employees
  • Full deletion on request, honoured within a stated timeframe
Draft, pending legal review

Terms

Straightforward terms of use, no auto-renewal traps, no hidden lock-in.

  • Your organisation owns everything OI Consultants produce on your behalf
  • Clear cancellation terms, stated plainly in the plan you sign up for
  • Service levels appropriate to your deployment tier, published not buried
Draft, pending legal review

Data handling

This is the one that matters most given what OI Workforce does, so here it is without qualification.

  • Your data is never used to train public AI models
  • With the sovereign appliance, data can stay entirely within your own infrastructure
  • Every autonomous action is logged to your organisation's ledger, see the audit-trail section above
  • Compliance alignment (UK GDPR, and regional equivalents in Ghana and India) confirmed per deployment, ask your account team for specifics
Draft, pending legal review

Security

Sovereignty means nothing without security to back it up. Here's how OI Workforce is actually protected.

  • End-to-end encryption for data in transit and at rest
  • Role-based access control down to individual document and system level
  • Every autonomous action logged and attributable, see the audit-trail ledger above
  • Independent security review planned ahead of general availability, details to follow
Before you ask

Questions, answered plainly.

Depending on the deployment you choose (cloud, private enterprise cloud, or fully offline appliance), your data can stay entirely within infrastructure you control. None of it is used to train public models.

Only within limits your organisation sets. Anything above your defined autonomy threshold (sending something externally, approving spend, changing a record) lands as a check-in for a named human owner, logged to the ledger either way.

With the sovereign appliance deployment, yes. It's built to run fully offline, not just tolerate an outage. This is a core design goal, not an edge case: teams in villages, mines, and other areas with limited or no internet access can run the full platform exactly as an office in a major city would.

English, Twi and Ga at launch, with Hindi and further languages on the roadmap. This is handled by GLIF, our language understanding layer, see above.

No. The sovereign appliance is an option for organisations that need fully offline or air-gapped deployment. Most teams get started on standard cloud deployment, no hardware required.
